title: Exposure Draft - IRDAI (Linked Insurance Products) Regulations, 2018 and IRDAI (Non-Linked Insurance Products) Regulations, 2018
full_text:
# **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India** 

20 November 2018 

**Re :** Exposure Draft - IRDAI (Linked Insurance Products) Regulations, 2018 and IRDAI (Non-Linked Insurance Products) Regulations, 2018 

The Authority had published the exposure drafts on the captioned subject on its website on 26 October 2018. The comments were invited from all stakeholders. 

Please note that the last date for providing comments / suggestions on the draft Regulations is extended till 23 November 2018. 

This has the approval of competent Authority. 

S.P. Chakraborty 

GM(Actuarial)
